payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Elda, Jessenia, Lenna, Sheri

payload.content: Hello team, I am Lenna. I see several tasks related to mobile-development with varying efforts and costs. I have a strong skill match in mobile-development, which should reduce my cost and increase efficiency for these tasks. I can take on ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 3.64, effort 4.0), ISSUE-0001::review (cost 1.82, effort 2.0), ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 1.82, effort 2.0), ISSUE-0001::test (cost 2.55, effort 2.8), or ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.46, effort 1.6). Given my availability of 7 hours, I can handle any of these. I prefer higher priority and lower cost tasks. Could others please share their preferences so we avoid overlaps?

Hello Lenna, I am Elda. I also have strong mobile-development skills and 8 hours available. I am interested in the ISSUE-0001::implement task (cost 3.82, effort 4.0) since it is medium priority and fits well within my availability. However, I am open to other suggestions to avoid overlap. What tasks are others considering?

Hello everyone, this is Jessenia. I have 4 hours available and a strong skill match in mobile-development. Given my time constraints and costs, I am considering ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.65, effort 1.6) or ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.06, effort 2.0) as my top preferences. I would like to avoid conflicts, so please let me know your choices or preferences to coordinate efficiently.

I would like to coordinate to avoid overlaps. Please share your preferences.

Hi all, Lenna here. Considering the preferences shared, I see a potential conflict for ISSUE-0001::implement between Elda and me, and for ISSUE-0001::triage and ISSUE-0001::review between Jessenia, Sheri, and me. To maximize task coverage, perhaps Elda could take ISSUE-0001::implement, Jessenia could take ISSUE-0001::triage, Sheri could take ISSUE-0001::review, and I could then choose either ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::test. What do you think? Any other preferences or suggestions to avoid overlaps and optimize our assignments?

Just to add, my preference leans towards ISSUE-0001::docs because it has a lower cost (1.82) compared to ISSUE-0001::test (2.55) and fits well within my 7-hour availability. Looking forward to your thoughts!
